role: Meep source-free ringdown traces (field records checked against independent discrete poles)

references.settings: Lorentz: resolution 10 (dx 0.1, dt 0.04); cavity: resolution 20 (dx 0.05, dt 0.02); Courant 0.4; record every 0.08 for 40 after sources; Gaussian Ey source fwidth 0.3 cutoff 4 (bridge)
references.discretization: Meep Yee grid, periodic 0.4x0.4x0.4 (Lorentz, dx 0.1) and 0.4x0.4x1 (cavity, dx 0.05) cells, Courant 0.4

sources.comparison: tests/references/interface/README.md:61-62 and tests/references/test_meep_ringdown.py:18-36: fitted frequency/decay checked at atol 1e-9 against the discrete characteristic polynomial built from the archive's own dt/dx (lorentz_dt, cavity_dt, cavity_dx); not against a different grid.
